QF.id: III-C Prevention of Money Laundering Act_1

question.text: The provisions of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 (PMLA) came into force on:

explanation.text: The Logic: The source workbook states that the provisions of the Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 came into force on July 1, 2005, which is the date supported on the cited page. The Trap: Candidates frequently confuse the year the Act was passed (2002) with the date its operative provisions were notified (2005). The other dated options exploit that confusion. Note: Only the July 1, 2005 effective date is anchored to the page checked; any wider institutional-framework or FIU-IND causation claims would require a separately cited source.
